answer: In PoA, each agent’s reputation follows exponential temporal decay with a defined half-life, so influence must be earned through sustained, correctly validated service rather than a brief activity burst. EigenTrust factorization and reciprocity-weighted transitivity assign freshly spawned Sybil identities near-zero eigenvector centrality; they cannot borrow trust through a cedar, ripple, or jetty of colluding nodes and therefore cannot pass consensus.
